text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since Yamanin Zephyr is preparing for sprint and mile G1s that will pit her against senior-year runners, knowing her opponents is going to be crucial.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And perhaps the most prominent of those opponents would be…

text_block_list.name: Driver
text_block_list.text: The meeting is scheduled to begin at 6:00 p.m., so I shall come to collect you forty minutes prior, Mastress Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'll see you then.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Daiichi Ruby. Hello.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Good day, Yamanin Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Daiichi Ruby. A member of a prestigious household so well known that even someone as aloof as me is familiar with her.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Can I help you with something?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. I've come to ask you a favor.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Will you consider joining me for some partner running?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (She is a frightful spring storm who's appeared on this year's mile front… and a radiant ruby dancing on the rushing wind.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I'm terribly sorry, but I'm afraid my schedule for today and tomorrow leaves me without a moment to spare.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: But if we were to arrange something for the day after tomorrow, at say five in the evening, then I'd gladly oblige.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "The family of magnificence."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's how people refer to her lofty house, which continually produces giants in their respective fields, from politics to finance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unsurprisingly, their family name shines resplendently in the history of the Twinkle Series as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiichi Ruby's grandmother received the URA Award twice for her remarkable achievements and went on to mentor younger racers after retirement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiichi Ruby's mother, known as "Peak Champion," was first in the family to claim the Oka Sho and secured the URA Award for the second generation in a row.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so the noble bloodline continues.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiichi Ruby is now heir to magnificence, the sacred crimson jewel of her family.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Trainer showed me her race results… It appears she was running against the storm in her classic year.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Though expected to continue the family legacy in the Triple Tiara tour, success eluded her, and she was forced to take time off and rest after falling ill that autumn.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (That said, after entering her senior year…)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Pant… Wheeze… Cough!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: …Right. Will that do it, then?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ah… Y-yes. Thank you… very much…

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: You're very welcome. Well then, good evening.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A composed Daiichi Ruby finds the time to bow to both of us as I rush over to Yamanin Zephyr, who's still struggling to catch her breath.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: She's strong. And fast. But above all…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It's the way she runs… Every single step she takes emits such sheer ambition. It's utterly…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Overwhelming…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The thing is… Daiichi Ruby isn't even the only racer Yamanin Zephyr needs to be conscious of.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's another runner she has to watch out for.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wahey, wahey! Wahey-hey-heeeyyy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Look at me, I'm rrrunnin' awayyy!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… Ugh, there's just no catching up with her!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: UrrrRRGH! Seriously… How is she so fast?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And she still has the energy to laugh… Daitaku Helios…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Such speed… Such incredible speed! A windstorm? A typhoon? No, faster!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (And on top of that…)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whew… Look at me, puttin' the W in "workout"! That was fire! ★

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: …Wait a sec. Huh? Huh? HUH?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Rubaaaeee!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Run with meee!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: She's even faster than she was before…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Helios… Her speed… It's as if it has no limit!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ruby and Helios…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: If the mile tour is where I hope to become the wind… I will have to surmount these two walls before me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But to think that the walls could be this high…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She mutters the words with a furrowed brow and an unusually frosty tone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I thought it would be prudent to broaden our perspective and get to grips with our upcoming opponents, but now…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've felt this since before her debut—Yamanin Zephyr's dedication to racing has always been pure, strong, and fierce…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But sometimes, those feelings she harbors can swirl around and form a storm inside—one that thrashes away at her mind and body.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Yes?
choice_data_list: We still have time. Let's come up with a plan together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Yes. Let's do that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her agree to continue in spite of her misgivings inspires me anew to help her any way I possibly can. I nod back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The storm into which Yamanin Zephyr intends to leap is only growing more and more intense…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A sudden news report sends the racing world into an uproar.
